summary: SuperAdmins can clear all pending changes at once, and Get Started walks a new environment through setup in a clearer order.

new.title: Discard all pending changes at once
new.text: A SuperAdmin can discard every pending change, including colleagues', in one step. The page shows how many and who staged them, asks for a reason and commits nothing.

new.title: Self-service setup for managed tenants
new.text: You can install a managed tenant with an enrollment key from Invardia. It creates the environment and licence and links it to its managing tenant.

fixes.title: Get Started in a clearer order
fixes.text: Naming convention is now step 1, then licence, engine permissions, mail sender and the rest. Engine permissions shows done as soon as every permission is held.

fixes.title: Templates skip roles your tenant lacks
fixes.text: Templates leave out roles your tenant does not have and say which, so a commit is no longer blocked. Two Entra role names now match Microsoft's current names.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Pending changes no longer lists the same item twice, Mail alerting points to Get Started, and hosting setup works in an empty Azure subscription.
